metadata.description: Delegation control plane for Claude Code: implementation goes to a GPT-6 Luna/Sol Codex lane by default and stays Claude-side for a named reason, each lane isolated in its own git worktree, routed by a deterministic policy with optional Jev adaptive routing (off by default), with a model-parameterized Claude-side implementer and a Fable 5 reviewer used in proportion to risk.

plugins.name: fable-advisor
plugins.description: Implementation goes to the Codex lane by default (GPT-6 Luna, or Sol for hard well-specified work) and stays Claude-side only for one of five named reasons. Obvious routes are decided by rule; optional Jev routing (FABLE_JEV_MODE=off|shadow|active) handles only the ambiguous middle behind a confidence gate. Every lane runs in a disposable worktree. Three lanes: Codex, a haiku/sonnet/fable implementer, and a read-only Fable 5 reviewer.
